description: The use of AI in financial markets can increase the speed, scope, and scale of systemic risks, including liquidity mismatches and procyclicality.

instances.assertion: The use of AI in financial markets can increase the speed, scope, and scale of systemic risks, including liquidity mismatches and procyclicality.
AI systems can cause systemic financial risk through liquidity mismatches, common exposures, and interconnectedness.
